Added shinytest tests for the recent bslib/thematic theming available for flexdashboard.

Ref: https://pkgs.rstudio.com/flexdashboard/articles/theme.html

Individual app/test directories are added and currently covering the following scenarios. Note that in the Rmarkdown output format, we had to specify the bootstrap version to `4`. title: Bootstrap 5 testing
description:
This PR modifies all relevant testing apps to use Bootstrap 5  (i.e., `bslib::bs_theme(version = 5)`).

After discussing with @shalutiwari today, we're thinking we won't expand the usual testing matrix to include Bootstrap 5. Instead, once we're close to a releasing, we'll open a PR like this one to get results for a specific version of Bootstrap that we're interested in. For this release, we need to specifically opt-in to using `version = 5` (since `version = 4` is still the default), but after this release it probably makes sense to maintain a `bslib` branch that adds `bs_theme()` instead of `bs_theme(version = 5)`.

title: testthat/integration tests for 5 apps
description:
This adds `testthat`-based unit/integration tests to 5 applications that would be exercised by the testthat action in https://github.com/rstudio/shinycoreci/pull/8

The most important lesson I learned was probably that in order for modules to be available in the test environment, it's important to provide the `env` argument to `testthat::test_file()`. Otherwise, `testthat` loads test files in a clean environment without the definitions added to the environment by `shiny::runTests()`.

It also occurred to me to add a first-class way to "click" an actionButton(); I created https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/2745 to track this.

I ran across what I think is a bug in `shiny::runTests()`: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/2746

Overall, I had some difficulty adding what I would consider to be "helpful" tests.
